About.title: Empowering the citizen through a sovereign platform
About.body: PALPASS is the unified national e-government platform of the State of Palestine. It binds public services to a portable digital identity, a national wallet, and a transparent transaction path for every verified citizen.
About.sovereignty_desc: A national digital infrastructure secured by institutional cryptography.
About.identity_desc: A 9-digit National ID, unforgeable and linked to official registries.
About.speed_desc: Complete transactions and verify documents without unnecessary in-person attendance.
About.privacy_desc: Your data is encrypted, and you control access permissions.

Healthcare.records_desc: Secure access to vaccinations, prescriptions, and accredited lab results.
